Question: Select the best translation into predicate logic. Some animals are neglected by cruel people. (Ax: x is an animal; Cx: x is cruel; Px: x is a person; Nxy: x neglects y)

Options: 
A. (∃x)[(Ax • Cx) • (∃y)(Py • Nyx)]
B. (∃x)[(Cx • Px) • (∃y)(Ay • Nxy)]
C. (∃x)[(Ax • Px) • (∃y)(Cy • Nxy)]
D. (∃x)(∃y){{[(Ax • Cy) • Py] • Nxy)]}}

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
